svg.title: Pop quiz, over Minneapolis in the purple rain: Craig is from the hometown of the artist who gave the world “Purple Rain”. Which city is it? Options: A, Detroit; B, Minneapolis; C, Chicago; D, Memphis. Pick one below; the answer is under them.
